extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental), immanen-, surpass or overstep, in file order. No stratum is set: the commentary does not separate the 1929 text from the 1937 annotations at these places.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-1057): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: The forming in judgment from which mathematical concepts arise takes place not at the transcendent objects but at the objects as presented in the judgment.
units.quote: takes place not at the "transcendent" objects but at the objects as presented in the judgment itself

units.claim: Categorial formations are not objectualities only while judging takes place; transcendence lies in their own being-sense, as enduring acquisitions.
units.quote: The categorial formations are not merely objectualities during and while the judging action takes place. In their own being-sense lies transcendence.

units.claim: Senses, as objects, are just as transcendent to their acts and subjects as objects that are not senses.
units.quote: The senses are, as objects, just as "transcendent" relative to their acts and subjects as objects that are not senses.

units.claim: The transcendent object consists within synthetic experience as the identity-pole immanent to the individual experiences and transcendent in the identity surpassing them.
units.quote: make understandable how the transcendent object consists within the sight-sphere of synthetic experience itself — as the identity-pole immanent to the individual experiences and yet transcendent in the identity surpassing them

units.claim: Every experienceable object, even a physical one, has a general ideality over against its constituting manifolds, and therein consists the transcendence of all objectualities over against consciousness.
units.quote: This is the general ideality of all intentional unities over against the manifolds constituting them. Therein consists the "transcendence" of all kinds of objectualities over against the consciousness of them.

units.claim: Objectualities are psychologized when their objectual sense is negated in favour of subjective experiences, data in immanent or psychological temporality.
units.quote: their objectual sense, their sense as a kind of objects of peculiar essence, is negated in favor of the subjective experiences, the data in immanent or psychological temporality

units.claim: Even immanent perception gives only a starting-point; full objectification of a psychic datum requires retention, protention and recollection.
units.quote: Even the so-called immanent perception gives only a starting-point; the full objectification of a psychic datum requires the synthetic accomplishments of retention, protention, and recollection.

units.claim: The universal essential form of intentional genesis is the constitution of immanent temporality, in which every experience receives and retains its identical time-position.
units.quote: The universal essential form of intentional genesis is the constitution of immanent temporality

absences.expected_because: Evidence as self-giving is introduced here, and §61 states how the transcendent object consists within synthetic experience as an identity-pole.
